name: @lacspace/tts
description: Engine-agnostic text-to-speech pipeline for Nepali and English newsrooms — @lacspace/speakable normalisation (numbers, BS dates, currency, acronyms, names) → edge-tts CLI (Microsoft neural voices, word-level timings from its subtitles), Piper offline voices, or any custom engine → audio plus word timings aligned back to the ORIGINAL text (engine WordBoundary events, or speakable estimates scaled to the real duration measured from the WAV/MP3 bytes without deps) → captionsync-ready segments. Voice registry (ne-NP Hemkala/Sagar, hi-IN and en-IN fallbacks, Piper ne_NP), content-hash cache. Bring your own engine binary; no bundled keys.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
